build_DPRAgent: build a DPR bi-encoder agent using DPRAgent with bert-base-uncased config for dense passage retrieval
build_DprQueryEncoder: build a DprQueryEncoder to encode query text into dense vectors using pretrained DPR weights
build_DprDocumentEncoder: build a DprDocumentEncoder to encode document text into dense vectors using pretrained DPR weights
build_DPRModel: build a DPRModel with separate query and document encoders for bi-encoder retrieval
build_BertTokenizerDictionaryAgent: build a BertTokenizerDictionaryAgent to tokenize text using the bert-base-uncased HuggingFace tokenizer
